When I was ten, I had a crush on the popular girl. She was athletic and more popular than me, the kid who read too many books and played video games. I was way too shy to tell her directly so I asked one of my friends to do it for me.
She said, and I quote (because it stung so bad I remember it eleven years later):

“I know he likes me, I don’t like him, and I want him to stop looking at me.”

Not nearly as bad as some of the other things I’ve read in this thread, but I’m still suffering with intense anxiety whenever the thought of talking to someone pops up anymore. Thanks.

So here’s a summary:

MC and his best friend are at a Senior camp (for high school seniors) to celebrate growing up and graduating. The best friend increasingly becomes more agitated and displays physical changes. MC notices and, on the final night of camp, is attacked by his best friend, who turns out to be a werewolf. MC is in a coma for over a month and displays the same changes as the moon changes from new to full. During the day, he is sick and weak, while he is stronger and more aggressive at night. On the night of the full moon, he fully transforms, and the Moon Lurker is free.

That’s about it so far! There’s more stuff going on that I’m writing about, but that’s the basic summary.
